🏐🔥 PFLUGERVILLE MEN’S VOLLEYBALL LEAGUE – SEASON 1 🏆

Get ready for competitive Sunday night volleyball!

📍 Location: 240 Martin Lane, Pflugerville, TX
📅 Every Sunday Night
🏐 Level: BB / A
⏳ Duration: 6 Weeks
👥 Limited to 6–8 Teams

💰 REGISTRATION:
• $85 per player
• $510 per team (6 players)

📝 TWO WAYS TO REGISTER:

👥 TEAM REGISTRATION
Already have a team? Register your squad and compete for the championship!

🙋 FREE AGENT REGISTRATION
Don’t have a team? No problem! Sign up individually, and we’ll help you find a team!

🏆 LEAGUE FORMAT & RULES:
• 6-week season
• Regular season + playoffs
• Competitive BB/A level
• Women are welcome to participate!
• Teams may play with only one middle blocker if they choose.

🥇 CHAMPIONSHIP PRIZES 🏆

Prizes will be awarded to the league champions!

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
• Limited spots available.
• Registration is confirmed once payment is received.
• Additional rules and schedules will be shared before the season begins.

🔥 BRING YOUR BEST GAME AND COMPETE FOR THE CHAMPIONSHIP!

🏐 SEE YOU ON THE COURT!
